book.name: SAN JUAN
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN JUAN

content: Cuybanile yin̈ teꞌ yoj uva yeb teꞌ iskꞌab
Yalni Comam Jesús tet ebnaj iscuywom: —Wal hanintiꞌan, caw lahaninan yeb xin hunu yoj teꞌ uva caw cꞌul, wal Inmaman xin, caw lahan yeb hunu mac chiilni teꞌ.

Kꞌinaloj tato ayej teꞌ iskꞌab mach chisatni, chitzocꞌlaxilto teꞌ yu naj chitan̈en teꞌ. Wal teꞌ iskꞌab caw cꞌul issatni xin, chiyilo naj istajinal iskꞌab teꞌ, hac tuꞌ xin caw chisatni teꞌ sicꞌlebil. Hacaꞌ iswatxꞌencan̈ naj teꞌ uva tuꞌ, caw hac tuꞌ chiyute istan̈en Inmaman macta ayxaco yul inkꞌaban.
Walex hex tiꞌ, caw sajxa ye heyanma yu cuybanile akꞌbilxa teyet wuhan.
Ayojab exn̈eticꞌaco win̈an, cat wehicꞌojan yul heyanma. Caw hacaꞌ hunu iskꞌab teꞌ uva tzocꞌbililto yin̈ yoj, matxa chisatni, caw hac tuꞌ heyehi tato machijex win̈an.

Wal hanintiꞌan, caw lahaninan yeb xin yoj teꞌ uva. Wal hexpaxo xin, caw lahanex hacaꞌ teꞌ iskꞌab. Yuxin ta ayexn̈eticꞌaco win̈an, ay inpaxicꞌojan teyin̈, lahanex hacaꞌ hunu iskꞌab teꞌ uva caw cꞌul issatni. Wal tato machijinan teyin̈, caw machi hunu tiꞌ chiyu hewatxꞌen hechuquil.
Wal mac mach chiehicꞌo win̈an xin, caw lahan chiutelax hacaꞌ teꞌ iskꞌab mach chiyakꞌ sat, chitzocꞌlaxiloj cat istajiloj. Chilahwi istajilo teꞌ xin, cat iscutxbalaxcan̈ teꞌ, cat yalaxto teꞌ yul kꞌaꞌ.
Tato hacn̈eticꞌa tuꞌ heyehico win̈an, machi xin checꞌayto heyijen cuybanile chiwalcanotiꞌan, kꞌanwe tzet choche hecꞌul chiakꞌlaxo teyet.
Ta hacaꞌ teꞌ iskꞌab caw satnom tuꞌ haquex tuꞌ, wal tuꞌ cheyeloj tato caw yeli incuywoman heyehi. Hac tuꞌ xin chiyu heyinican̈ isbi Inmaman.
Hacaꞌ isxahanil ayinan yu Inmamtuꞌan, hac tuꞌ isxahanil chexwilpaxojan. Yuxin xahann̈ehojabn̈eticꞌa cheyil heba, hacaꞌ isxahanil ayex wuhan.
Tato cheyije chejbanile chiwakꞌcanojan teyet tiꞌ, chexahann̈e heba, hacaꞌ isxahanil ayex wuhan. Yuto hac tuꞌ wehan yeb xin Inmaman, caw xahan chexwilan, hacaꞌ iscꞌulchꞌanil iscꞌul Inmaman.
Caw chiwalan huntekꞌan tiꞌ teyet yun̈e hacaꞌ istzala incꞌultiꞌan, hac tuꞌ heyabenpaxo tzalahilal wintajan; haxinwal caw chitzꞌajnacano huneꞌ tzalahilal tuꞌ yul heyanma.
Haꞌ huneꞌ chejbanile tiꞌ chiwalcanojan teyet, caw xahanojab cheyil heba hununex hacaꞌ isxahanil chexwilan.
Hac tiꞌ chiyu coyeniloj tato caw xahan aycano hunu jamigo ju, tato hinanon̈ jakꞌni camo coba yin̈.
Tato cheyije tzet chiwaltiꞌan, caw wamigohan heyehi.
Walex hex tiꞌ, caw matxa chexwalan inchejabojan, yuto hunu naj chejab caw mach yohtajo naj tzet chiswatxꞌe yahaw, wal xin chexwalan wamigohojan, yuto xawalan teyet sunil tzet halbil wetan yu Inmaman.

Maẍtajex quinhesayilojan, haninan quexinsayilojan, quexwanicojan yin̈ hemunil yun̈e lahan chexelico hacaꞌ hunu teꞌ satnom teꞌ caw niman sat chakꞌa, haꞌ xin sunil huntekꞌan chewatxꞌe tuꞌ ayn̈eticꞌa yin̈ sunilbal tiempo. Hac tuꞌ xin tzijxan̈e ye tuꞌ chekꞌan tet Inmaman yin̈ inbihan, chiakꞌlax teyet.
Yuxinto caw chiwalcanojan teyet, caw xahan cheyille heba hununex.
Yal Comam Jesús ta caj chil anma macta chaco isba yul iskꞌab Comam
Yalnipaxo Comam Jesús: —Tato chexcajlax yu anma ay yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, nawetij tato caj quinyilpaxojan anma.

Kꞌinalo tato ayextoco xol tzet chiswatxꞌe anma tiꞌ, caw xahanmi chexyila, hacaꞌ isxahanil chil isba. Wal xin caw haninan quexinsiquꞌilojan xol anma, yuxinticꞌa chexiscaj anma, yuto matxa ayexoco xol tzet chiswatxꞌe.

Tijab yul hecꞌul yet walnihan teyet hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Naj cꞌamteꞌ caw mach ecꞌbalo naj sata ispatrón,” yuxin tato caw quincajlaxan yu anma, haꞌ quexpax tuꞌ chal tuꞌ, chexcajlaxpaxo yu anma. Wal tato isyije anma intzotiꞌan walan tet xin, haquex pax tuꞌ, chisyije anma cuybanile cheyala.
Caw chexecꞌoyaꞌ yu anma isyayil ayexico yul inkꞌaban. Chiyute anma huneꞌ tuꞌ yuto caw mach yohtajo anma tuꞌ Mac an̈eintijan.
Kꞌinalo tato caw mach quinhulan walaꞌan cuybanile tet anma, caw machmi ismul anma yin̈. Wal tinan̈ xin, caw matxa tzet tzꞌaj yalaꞌ yu iscolni isba yin̈ ismul tuꞌ.
Macn̈eticꞌa chincajnihan, chiscajpaxo Inmaman.

Sunil tzet inyehan xol anma, caw maẍto hunu mac chiyeni yilaꞌ anma hacaꞌ tuꞌ. Kꞌinalo tato machi cꞌaybalcꞌule inyehan xol anma, caw machim ismul anma, chal tuꞌ. Wal xin, waxan̈ca caw yil anma huntekꞌan tuꞌ, yaj to caw chiniscajan, chiscajpaxo Inmaman.
Yajaꞌ caw chu huntekꞌan tiꞌ, yun̈e yijnicano isba sunil tzet tzꞌibn̈ebilcano yin̈ Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios bay chala:

content.text: Caw machi inmulan tet anma, yaj to caw yaco ishowal win̈an, ẍiayoj.

content: Yaj ay huneꞌ Comam chicolwa teyin̈ chitit bey Inmaman, haꞌ ton xin Comam Espíritu Santo, Comam han̈e isyelal chala. Haninan chintohan inchejaꞌtijan Comam tuꞌ. Yet ay Comam texol chitzotelo win̈an.
Haquexpax tuꞌ hex tiꞌ, caw chextzotelo win̈an yuto caw huneꞌn̈eticꞌa hetzujico wintajan yettaxticꞌa wichicojan walnihan istzotiꞌ Inmaman.
